description: Several small plastic bowls in different shades of blue sit on a dark blue cloth in front of a pale pillow. The left hand rests near the bottom while the right hand reaches to the light purple bowl on the right, lifts it and places it onto a stack of bowls, then lifts a light turquoise bowl and stacks it as well, and finally picks up the remaining dark teal bowl and sets it on top to make one neat stack; throughout, the bowls are a right-hand object and the left hand is not touching anything.
